behavior: Quality-enabled validation requires a natively accepted lint receipt; findings remain advisory. Disabled quality does not inherit this prerequisite.
Applicable Advisory policy requires a valid assessment; accepted negative findings do not block. No authority, gate or threshold was relaxed.
Composed conclusion now preserves PolicyTransitionRejected and the existing REST/MCP projection, including reason codes, receipts and locked decision.
No applicable policy metrics project as ready/off/not applicable, not fabricated Advisory enforcement.
Reads do not mutate state; denied writes preserve version, edition, reviews, activity, events, history and receipts; promotion reuses decomposition and never rewrites policy/lint evidence.
